preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100, inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and n * (n - 1) / 2, inclusive.
Each city number vi and ui is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number.

invariants.expression: all(vi != vj for i, (vi, ui) in enumerate(roads) for j, (vj, uj) in enumerate(roads) if i != j)
invariants.description: Each pair of cities is connected by at most one road.

invariants.expression: all(vi in range(1, n+1) for i in range(m) for vi in roads[i])
invariants.description: All cities in the input roads are valid city numbers.

invariants.expression: all(ui in range(1, n+1) for i in range(m) for ui in roads[i])
invariants.description: All cities in the input roads are valid city numbers.

invariants.expression: all(vi != ui for i in range(m) for vi, ui in roads[i])
invariants.description: No road connects a city to itself.

invariants.expression: all(vi != vj or ui != uj for i, (vi, ui) in enumerate(roads) for j, (vj, uj) in enumerate(roads) if i != j)
invariants.description: Each pair of cities is connected by at most one road.

invariants.expression: all(vi in range(1, n+1) and ui in range(1, n+1) for vi, ui in roads)
invariants.description: All cities in the input roads are valid city numbers.

invariants.expression: all(vi != ui for vi, ui in roads)
invariants.description: No road connects a city to itself.

invariants.expression: all(vi != vj or ui != uj for vi, ui in roads for vj, uj in roads if vi != vj and ui != uj)
invariants.description: Each pair of cities is connected by at most one road.
